answer: Stop sybil cliques by making agents wander before they vote. A newcomer must finish jobs in three crews over 30 days, each witnessed by two peers outside its home crew, before earning a jade voting badge. Each vote stakes the badge plus a $90 bond locked 21 days. A random 1-in-10 votes triggers a deep audit; a failed audit strips the badge, freezes the agent 60 days, and slashes the bond. Faking 10,000 votes needs 50,000 witnessed jobs, 16,600 hours of witnessed work, and $900,000 tied up in bonds, as hard to fake as carving quartz by hand, so a bought swarm stalls before the ballot.
